scope: Audit of short approvable leftovers in the final step, plus edits preceded by an acknowledgement word (listo/va/ok/dale/perfecto…), pickup/delivery switches and single-line quantity nudges
auditOfPlannedItem: Probe of 25 final-step messages combining address, phone, payment, fulfillment, notes, cash, name and cart edits with approval words: none created the order without «confirmar» after the batch 30 fix. Pure approvals («listo, gracias», «dale, confirmo», «ok, confirmar», «listo eso es todo») still approve, as intended.
baselineFindings: Dropped silently (cart re-shown): «listo pero tráeme cambio de 50 mil», «va y que llegue rápido», «listo, es para mi mamá», «dale, bien empacado», «ok, sin hielo», «listo, el nombre es Laura», «listo, quita uno», «va, agrega otro», «ok, mejor para recoger»

The acknowledgement leaked into data: address «va, a la carrera 15 #20-30»; «listo, torre 2 apto 301» replaced the whole address; reference and order note «perfecto, entrégalo en la portería» (duplicated)
«el pedido va con transferencia» answered «Para ubicar tu pedido, necesito el número de orden»
«para recoger» alone did nothing; «mejor a domicilio» on a delivery order dropped the final step to building_cart with «¿Qué se te antoja?»
«quita uno» / «agrega otro» / «uno más» with a single dish line were dropped or answered «No encontré ese producto»
fix: Before routing, in building_cart and awaiting_final_confirm a leading acknowledgement word with a separator (comma/period or pues/entonces/pero/y) is removed when the rest is a real instruction (not an approval, closing or courtesy). «el pedido/la orden/todo va|queda|se paga con <enabled method>» is rewritten as «pago con <method>». looksLikePickupOnlySwitch accepts «(mejor) para/a recoger (en el local)» and «lo recogemos» (isPickupIntent unchanged). tryHandleDeliverySetup with a cart and no address: already delivery with an address → says so and keeps the step (final summary); from pickup → switches to delivery and asks for the address (awaiting_address). tryHandleSingleLineQuantityNudge: with exactly one dish line and no per-unit add-ons tied to it, «quita/saca uno», «uno menos», «agrega/pon/dame otro», «uno más» change that line by one unit; at ×1 «quita uno» explains how to remove it.
historicalRegressionsCaughtAndFixed: ambiguous-turns «Quiero un churrasco para recoger y también domicilio» emptied the cart when «para recoger» was added to isPickupIntent globally; the phrase is now accepted only in the pickup-only switch
knownGaps: «mi número es 3001234567, va» (trailing acknowledgement) updates the phone without the explicit acknowledgement line
Quantity nudges with several dish lines keep existing routes
«Domicilio a X ✅ ¿Qué se te antoja?» wording for a new address with a non-empty cart outside the final step
